blogPosts.title: Solid Surface Maintenance Tips for Geelong Climates
blogPosts.excerpt: Keep your benchtops and furniture in top condition with maintenance advice tailored for Geelong's weather and lifestyle.
body: Maintaining solid surface benchtops in North Shore requires regular care to preserve their appearance, especially given Geelong's coastal climate. Simple cleaning routines with mild soap and water prevent staining and damage.

For kitchen benchtops, avoid placing hot pots directly on the surface, as extreme heat can cause discolouration. In Geelong homes, using trivets or mats is advisable, and our materials are designed to withstand daily kitchen activities.
Bathroom vanities need protection from harsh chemicals. We recommend gentle cleaners to maintain the surface integrity, ensuring longevity for North Shore bathrooms where humidity is a factor.

Long-term maintenance includes periodic professional inspections. We advise North Shore homeowners to schedule checks every few years to address any wear, keeping surfaces optimal for performance and aesthetics.
